digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler: live Jira DC integration testing
propositions: the epic's headline AC requires bidirectional proof live: a DC-created issue appears locally inbound and a local edit appears in DC outbound, both against a real store copy
isolation is enforced by separate repo with no git remote, scrubbed of production bindings and snapshots, with REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off as a second layer
28 mutations (14 inbound × 14 outbound) must round-trip individually and be asserted by named oracles, not by aggregate convergence, with per-direction idempotence verified by repeated pass
the store copy is the real project's tickets branch, counted structurally on the filesystem to detect partial extraction, scrubbed by enumerating .bridge_state* rather than a hardcoded list
pagination must be observed from the instance, seeded at 2*observed+1 to force multiple pages, and fully recovered from a filtered dry-run pass over an unfiltered set
